## Summary

Describe the problem and the approach taken.

## Validation

List the platforms, builds, tests, or gameplay scenarios used to validate the
change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated formatting or generated output.
- [ ] I tested the latest `main` revision and documented relevant results.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible or workflow changes.
- [ ] I preserved supported-platform behavior or clearly documented platform-specific limitations.
- [ ] This pull request contains no ISO, XEX/XEXP, extracted asset, save, cache, or unauthorized game material.
- [ ] Any ReXGlue changes are represented as reproducible ordered patches rather than uncommitted submodule changes.
